prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1088; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while the patient was turning left. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain with radiation into the upper trapezius region, along with low back pain and stiffness the following morning. Examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness, and mild lumbar guarding without neurological deficit. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation based on clinical findings.

Treatment over the course of care consisted of f14 supervised visits... [see correction below]

Corrected version:

Treatment over the course of care consisted of fourteen supervised visits and included manual therapy, targeted therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, heat and cold modalities, and a home exercise program. Pain levels and range of motion improved steadily across the course of treatment. At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported residual intermittent neck stiffness with improved tolerance for daily activities and work duties. The patient is expected to continue a home exercise program and return for reassessment if symptoms recur or fail to resolve.
